content.value: A rural household has 1.5 bigha land with standing rice-field, 0.75 bighafruit (15) forest, 0.5 bigha homestead with semi-pucca structure and 0.25 bigha fishpond. Propose a cash compensation framework as per the ARIPO, 1982.
